#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

class Main {
public:
    void run() {
        int n, k;
        cin >> n >> k;
        
        vector<int> v(10, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int idx;
            cin >> idx;
            v[idx] = 1;
        }
        
        vector<int> ans = {1};
        int p = n / 2;
        
        while (true) {
            if (p & 1) {
                ans = multiplyPolynomials(ans, v, MOD);
            }
            p >>= 1;
            if (p == 0) break;
            v = multiplyPolynomials(v, v, MOD);
        }
        
        long long res = 0;
        for (int x : ans) {
            res = (res + (long long)x * x) % MOD;
        }
        cout << res << endl;
    }
    
    vector<int> multiplyPolynomials(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
        int need = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
        int n = 1;
        while (n < need) n <<= 1;
        
        vector<double> aReal(n, 0.0);
        vector<double> aImag(n, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
            long long x = ((long long)a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
            aReal[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
            aImag[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        
        fft(aReal, aImag, false);
        
        vector<double> bReal(n, 0.0);
        vector<double> bImag(n, 0.0);
        if (a == b) {
            copy(aReal.begin(), aReal.end(), bReal.begin());
            copy(aImag.begin(), aImag.end(), bImag.begin());
        } else {
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); i++) {
                long long x = ((long long)b[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
                bReal[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
                bImag[i] = x >> 15;
            }
            fft(bReal, bImag, false);
        }
        
        vector<double> resReal(n, 0.0);
        vector<double> resImag(n, 0.0);
        double cf = 0.25 / n;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);
            
            double ar = aReal[i] + aReal[j];
            double ai = aImag[i] - aImag[j];
            double ac = aImag[i] + aImag[j];
            double ad = aReal[j] - aReal[i];
            
            double br = bReal[i] + bReal[j];
            double bi = bImag[i] - bImag[j];
            double bc = bImag[i] + bImag[j];
            double bd = bReal[j] - bReal[i];
            
            resReal[i] = (ar * br - ai * bi) * cf - (ac * bd + ad * bc) * cf;
            resImag[i] = (ar * bi + ai * br) * cf + (ac * bc - ad * bd) * cf;
        }
        
        fft(resReal, resImag, true);
        
        vector<int> result(need);
        for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
            long long real = llround(resReal[i]);
            long long imag = llround(resImag[i]);
            long long realLow = real % mod;
            long long realHigh = (imag % mod);
            result[i] = (int)((realLow + (realHigh << 15)) % mod);
        }
        return result;
    }
    
    void fft(vector<double>& re, vector<double>& im, bool inverse) {
        int n = re.size();
        for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int bit = n >> 1;
            for (; j >= bit; bit >>= 1) j -= bit;
            j += bit;
            if (i < j) {
                swap(re[i], re[j]);
                swap(im[i], im[j]);
            }
        }
        
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int half = len >> 1;
            vector<double> cos(half);
            vector<double> sin(half);
            for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
                double angle = 2 * M_PI * i / len * (inverse ? -1 : 1);
                cos[i] = cos(angle);
                sin[i] = sin(angle);
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                    double uRe = re[i + j];
                    double uIm = im[i + j];
                    double vRe = re[i + j + half] * cos[j] - im[i + j + half] * sin[j];
                    double vIm = re[i + j + half] * sin[j] + im[i + j + half] * cos[j];
                    
                    re[i + j] = uRe + vRe;
                    im[i + j] = uIm + vIm;
                    re[i + j + half] = uRe - vRe;
                    im[i + j + half] = uIm - vIm;
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (inverse) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                re[i] /= n;
                im[i] /= n;
            }
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    Main mainInstance;
    mainInstance.run();
    return 0;
}
